summary.text: MyKala Voita is a Republican state senator from South Dakota Senate District 21 who assumed office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: MyKala Voita's career experience includes working as a self-employed laborer/operator.
Voita assumed office in the South Dakota State Senate on January 14, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session she is assigned to the Senate Appropriations Committee.
